title: Payment-Record Relief on Home Comfort Financing Returned-Payment Fees
content:
On Home Comfort Financing, the returned-payment payment-record relief is 10 percent when the returned-payment payment-record count is at least 12, 5 percent when it is at least 6 but below 12, and zero when it is below 6.

The returned-payment payment-record count is the payments counted for the borrower's payment record in the 12 whole months before the date of handling, less the returned payments posted in those 12 whole months (each returned-payment entry takes one away).

| Returned-payment payment-record count | Returned-payment payment-record relief |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 10 percent |
| 6 to 11 | 5 percent |
| below 6 | zero |

The relief is one of the returned-payment reliefs; the returned-payment reliefs are added together into the returned-payment relief percentage, and the scheduled returned-payment fee is reduced once by that total — the reliefs never act one after another.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Payments counted | Returned payments in the 12 whole months | Count | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | 1 | 12 | 10 percent |
| 12 | 1 | 11 | 5 percent |
| 7 | 1 | 6 | 5 percent |
| 6 | 1 | 5 | zero |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A scheduled returned-payment fee of $20.00, with this relief at 5 percent and the account's other returned-payment reliefs totalling 30 percent: the relief percentage is 35, and the fee is $20.00 multiplied by 65 and divided by 100, $13.00.
